data.description:
## Context / Problem
The recovered 2026-08-16 janitor plan contains approved-but-lossy RP-02 through RP-06 decisions. Before these items become implementation stories, the maintainer needs evidence-backed discussions that preserve prior architectural intent, cover hard-won bug and test behavior, and resolve implementation-critical ambiguities. The authoritative recovery basis is `.joe-janitor/report-2026-08-16-recovered.md`; exact source and prior-decision evidence lives in the modules, tests, ADRs, tickets, and commit history cited there.

## Approach
Research each RP independently against current source, focused behavioral tests, ticket/ADR/commit history, and relevant maintained-project prior art. Record a decision-ready brief per RP under the checkout-local `.joe-janitor/` archive, with the situation, intended end state, invariants versus intentional behavior changes, edge/failure scenarios, concrete implementation seams, migration/rollback considerations, and remaining maintainer-only decisions. Use read-only or checkout-local probes where framework behavior is uncertain. This fits the janitor approval phase because it reduces ambiguity without editing production code or prematurely creating implementation stories.

## Scope
No tracked repository file changes. Read-only scope includes `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/`, `src/rebar/_cli/`, `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/`, their focused tests, `docs/adr/`, and exact historical tickets/commits. Outputs live in `.joe-janitor/rp02-*.md` through `.joe-janitor/rp06-*.md`, the recovered report, and ticket comments.

## Verification
This is an investigation task. Evidence crosses source boundaries through focused existing tests and narrowly scoped checkout-local probes. The oracles are exact current outcomes, failure modes, ownership boundaries, call/reference inventories, and cited historical decisions; any behavior change is labeled as a maintainer decision rather than silently treated as an invariant.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] [operator-attested] RP-02 has a decision-ready brief mapping BindingStore responsibilities, atomicity constraints, prior ADR/ticket intent, focused test oracles, extraction seams, migration hazards, and remaining choices; verified by read-back of its `.joe-janitor/` note and ticket summary.
- [ ] [operator-attested] RP-03 has a decision-ready brief mapping outbound lifecycle protocol calls, lossy failure paths, resurrection/idempotency scenarios, prior ticket intent, focused test oracles, migration hazards, and remaining choices; verified by read-back of its `.joe-janitor/` note and ticket summary.
- [ ] [operator-attested] RP-04 has a decision-ready brief mapping configured versus ambient tracker/Jira ownership, all bypass call sites, mixed-context failure scenarios, prior ADR/ticket intent, focused test oracles, migration hazards, and remaining choices; verified by read-back of its `.joe-janitor/` note and ticket summary.
- [ ] [operator-attested] RP-05 has a decision-ready brief mapping CLI routing responsibilities and compatibility seams, prior split history, focused test oracles, extraction alternatives, migration hazards, and remaining choices; verified by read-back of its `.joe-janitor/` note and ticket summary.
- [ ] [operator-attested] RP-06 has a decision-ready brief mapping plan-review policy ownership, registry/orchestrator/facade coupling, routing divergence, compatibility constraints, focused test oracles, extraction alternatives, migration hazards, and remaining choices; verified by read-back of its `.joe-janitor/` note and ticket summary.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Every substantive claim cites repository, tracker, history, test, or maintained-project evidence, and every behavior delta is explicitly marked for maintainer approval; verified by a citation/decision-queue audit recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The recovered janitor report links the RP-02-RP-06 briefs and states their approval-readiness status; verified by read-back against the local notes.
